title: Ford's Theatre
visualBrief: Red-brick theatre with five-bay white stone arcade, two tiers of tall arched windows, raised central pediment and slate gable.

appearance.colorEncoding: sRGB palette decoded to linear COLOR_0

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: Reviewed front terrain reference at model Y0 and foundation down to -1.25 m; preserved Terrarium footprint samples span -0.773 to 0.376 m relative to this reference. Current source-terrain captures show visible steps and no floating foundations.

terrainReference.basis: Front ground reference in the signed local map frame; separately preserved terrain-grid.json.

geographicProposal.notes: The mapped envelope includes a 23.23 m theatre rectangle and approximately 10 m lower south frontage with shorter depth. Partition at the mapped rear step is a photographic/map interpretation, not a surveyed party wall. Source model includes both masses and preserves the rear step; it omits other adjoining buildings and interiors. HABS DC-82 side/rear elevations guide sparse service openings and three roof ventilators; current facade follows 2014/2016 local Qualla photos.

limitations: Current five-bay theatre and lower south Star Saloon wing, original medium-fi exterior geometry. No interiors, neighboring taller buildings or borrowed meshes.

Generalized Protomaps ensemble partition and facade proportions are estimates. Qualla 2014/2016 photographs control the visible front; historical HABS side/rear drawings guide otherwise unseen ventilation and service form.

Terrarium host samples supply ground evidence, not a survey. The foundation extends 1.25 m below the street reference; terrain-contact placement samples the declared front reference point. Dataset resolution and vertical accuracy remain host-dependent.

Fine carved window ornament and small hardware are simplified; archival rear openings/roof vents are interpreted where current photographs do not show them. Photographs and drawings are not embedded or redistributed.
sourceLicense: Original authored geometry under repository license; map controls © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference photographs are not redistributed.
